label: v374
changes: Shared Actions give each next step an owner and a due date, with record links, renewal suggestions, completion history and safe offline recovery.
Invites now reserve seats, join the space and record estate nominations together, so concurrent attempts cannot reuse a code or overfill the last seat.
Vault files now check current access whenever they are opened. Child accounts stay read-only, removed members lose access, and old permanent download links are retired.
Protected credentials and shared facts use separate encryption purposes and explicit space checks. Unreadable records are preserved and show recovery instructions.
Family-tree branches connect every biological parent, including co-parents without a recorded partner relationship.
